<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><style>body{background:#151923;color:#eee;font:14px system-ui;margin:12px}canvas{touch-action:none;cursor:default;width:100%;max-width:920px;display:block;border:1px solid #856b43}button,input{accent-color:#c8a15d;background:#303747;color:#eee;padding:6px}label{display:inline-block;margin:8px}small{color:#cdbb9c}</style></head><body><h2>Ironbound — Interactive Rig Assembly v6</h2><canvas id="c" width="920" height="588"></canvas><label>Breathing <input id="breath" type="range" min="0" max="100" value="35"><span id="v">35%</span></label><label>Size <input id="size" type="range" min="65" max="135" value="100"><span id="sv">100%</span></label><label>Animation <select id="mode"><option selected>Assembly</option><option>Idle</option><option>Slash</option></select></label><label>Shadow <input id="shadow" type="range" min="0" max="150" value="100"></label><label><input id="joints" type="checkbox"> Show joints</label><label>Timeline <input id="timeline" type="range" min="0" max="1000" value="0"></label><button id="pause">Pause</button><button id="reset">Restart</button><label><input id="old" type="checkbox"> Compare approved idle artwork</label><p>Click a visible armor piece to select it, then drag to move it. Drag the gold rotation handle to rotate; drag a corner to resize. Alt-click cycles overlapping pieces. Arrow keys nudge the selected part.</p><div id="assembly" style="border:1px solid #626b7b;padding:10px;margin:8px 0"><label>Part <select id="part"></select></label><span id="partFields"></span><button id="resetPart">Reset part</button><button id="resetAll">Reset assembly</button><button id="exportRig">Export settings</button><button id="importRig">Import settings</button><label><input type="checkbox" id="ghost"> Approved artwork overlay</label><textarea id="rigText" style="display:block;width:98%;height:65px;background:#202531;color:#eee" placeholder="Export or paste rig settings here"></textarea><small id="rigStatus"></small></div><p>Assembly mode is the new idle rig. Slash is the previous prototype for reference only.</p><script>
const sources=/*SHARED_SCENE*/{};const art="data:image/webp;base64,";const $=id=>document.getElementById(id),ctx=$('c').getContext('2d'),I={};let paused=false,t=0,last=0;
for(const [k,v] of Object.entries({...sources,newIron:art})){if(typeof v!=='string')continue;let im=new Image();im.onload=()=>I[k]=im;im.src=v}
$('pause').onclick=()=>{paused=!paused;$('pause').textContent=paused?'Play':'Pause'};$('reset').onclick=()=>t=0;
const C=x=>Math.max(0,Math.min(1,x)), E=x=>{x=C(x);return x*x*(3-2*x)}, mix=(a,b,t)=>a+(b-a)*t;
$('mode').onchange=()=>{t=0;paused=false;$('pause').textContent='Pause'};
$('timeline').oninput=()=>{t=+$('timeline').value/1000*1.25;paused=true;$('pause').textContent='Play'};
function contact(x,y,k,step){let a=+$('shadow').value/100;for(let [dx,rx,ry,opacity] of [[0,61,10,.55],[-35,20,5,.82],[34+step,22,5,.88]]){ctx.save();ctx.translate(x+dx*k,y);ctx.scale(rx*k,ry*k);let g=ctx.createRadialGradient(0,0,0,0,0,1);g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(3,5,10,'+C(opacity*a)+')');g.addColorStop(.52,'rgba(3,5,10,'+C(opacity*a*.65)+')');g.addColorStop(1,'transparent');ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fillRect(-1,-1,2,2);ctx.restore()}}


const modularArt={"head":"data:image/webp;base64,","torso":"data:image/webp;base64,","cape":"data:image/webp;base64,","tabard":"data:image/webp;base64,","upper":"data:image/webp;base64,","fore":"data:image/webp;base64,","hand":"data:image/webp;base64,","thigh":"data:image/webp;base64,","shin":"data:image/webp;base64,","boot":"data:image/webp;base64,","sword":"data:image/webp;base64,","shield":"data:image/webp;base64,"},P={};
for(const [name,src] of Object.entries(modularArt)){const im=new Image();im.onload=()=>P[name]=im;im.src=src}
const rad=Math.PI/180;
function rigPose(x,y,k,q,b){
if(Object.keys(P).length!==12){if(I.newIron)ctx.drawImage(I.newIron,x-96*k,y-182*k,192*k,182*k);return}
const wind=E(q/.24)*(1-E((q-.26)/.16)),hit=E((q-.26)/.18)*(1-E((q-.57)/.35)),step=E((q-.16)/.28)*(1-E((q-.62)/.32));
ctx.save();ctx.translate(x,y);ctx.scale(k,k);
function piece(n,px,py,w,h,ax=.5,ay=.5,a=0){ctx.save();ctx.translate(px,py);ctx.rotate(a*rad);ctx.drawImage(P[n],-w*ax,-h*ay,w,h);ctx.restore()}
function joint(px,py,a,fn){ctx.save();ctx.translate(px,py);ctx.rotate(a*rad);fn();if($('joints').checked){ctx.fillStyle='#f6d069';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,0,2.1,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill()}ctx.restore()}
function limb(hip,foot,front){
const dx=foot[0]-hip[0],dy=foot[1]-hip[1],L1=35,L2=36,d=Math.max(1,Math.min(70.9,Math.hypot(dx,dy))),base=Math.atan2(dy,dx),bend=Math.acos(C((d*d+L1*L1-L2*L2)/(2*d*L1))),angle=base-bend;
const knee=[hip[0]+Math.cos(angle)*L1,hip[1]+Math.sin(angle)*L1];
const a1=(angle-Math.PI/2)/rad,a2=(Math.atan2(foot[1]-knee[1],foot[0]-knee[0])-Math.PI/2)/rad;
piece('thigh',hip[0],hip[1],31,47,.5,.15,a1);
piece('shin',knee[0],knee[1],26,46,.5,.09,a2);
piece('boot',foot[0]+3,foot[1],34,25,.48,.72,0);
if($('joints').checked){for(const p of [hip,knee,foot]){ctx.fillStyle='#f6d069';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(...p,2.2,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill()}}
}
const hipY=-75+4*wind+3*hit,bodyX=3*wind+12*hit;
const rear=[-39-22*step,-8],front=[34+9*step,-8];
piece('cape',bodyX+5,hipY-60,121,99,.83,.09,-4*wind-12*hit+Math.sin(t*3)*1.4);
limb([bodyX-13,hipY],rear,false);limb([bodyX+17,hipY],front,true);
ctx.save();ctx.translate(bodyX,hipY);ctx.rotate((-4*wind+9*hit)*rad);ctx.translate(0,-b*35);
piece('tabard',0,1,30,55,.5,.04,-4*hit);
joint(25,-53,9*wind-15*hit,()=>{piece('upper',0,5,34,31,.5,.25);joint(7,22,-20-12*wind+10*hit,()=>{piece('fore',0,7,29,31,.5,.2);joint(6,22,12*wind-8*hit,()=>piece('shield',4,-5,56,78,.45,.45))})});
piece('torso',0,-33,81,60);
piece('head',6,-77,38,48,.5,.5,-4*wind+5*hit);
joint(-27,-50,-28*wind-46*hit,()=>{piece('upper',0,6,37,33,.5,.2);joint(0,24,-24-72*wind-25*hit,()=>{piece('fore',0,8,29,32,.5,.15);joint(0,25,30*wind+66*hit,()=>{piece('sword',0,0,111,55,.15,.79,26);piece('hand',0,0,24,26,.48,.38)})})});
ctx.restore();ctx.restore();
}

const defaults=[
 ['cape','cape',-22,-120,108,113,-8,0,.73,.10],
 ['rearThigh','thigh',-21,-78,34,48,20,1,.5,.12],
 ['rearShin','shin',-37,-39,29,43,18,2,.5,.10],
 ['rearBoot','boot',-46,-8,33,25,0,3,.5,.68],
 ['frontThigh','thigh',17,-78,35,47,-19,4,.5,.12],
 ['frontShin','shin',31,-38,29,43,8,5,.5,.10],
 ['frontBoot','boot',34,-8,35,25,0,6,.5,.68],
 ['shieldUpper','upper',24,-124,36,34,-20,7,.5,.15],
 ['shieldFore','fore',36,-103,31,36,-32,8,.5,.15],
 ['torso','torso',0,-115,82,68,0,9,.5,.5],
 ['tabard','tabard',1,-84,32,62,0,10,.5,.05],
 ['head','head',7,-164,39,47,0,11,.5,.5],
 ['swordUpper','upper',-26,-127,37,35,12,12,.5,.18],
 ['swordFore','fore',-31,-105,31,37,-48,13,.5,.13],
 ['sword','sword',-9,-89,101,50,-2,14,.15,.79],
 ['swordHand','hand',-9,-89,25,26,-20,15,.48,.40],
 ['shieldHand','hand',48,-85,22,23,0,16,.5,.4],
 ['shield','shield',49,-97,57,82,0,17,.5,.5]
].map(([id,asset,x,y,w,h,angle,z,ax,ay])=>({id,asset,x,y,w,h,angle,z,ax,ay,visible:true}));
let assembly=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(defaults));
const fields=[['x','X',-160,160,1],['y','Y',-230,20,1],['w','Width',5,180,1],['h','Height',5,180,1],['angle','Rotation',-180,180,1],['z','Layer',-10,40,1],['ax','Pivot X',0,1,.01],['ay','Pivot Y',0,1,.01]];
function selectedPart(){return assembly.find(p=>p.id===$('part').value)}
function controls(){let p=selectedPart();if(!p)return;let f=$('partFields');f.replaceChildren();for(let [key,label,min,max,step] of fields){let l=document.createElement('label'),i=document.createElement('input');l.textContent=label+' ';i.type='number';i.min=min;i.max=max;i.step=step;i.value=p[key];i.style.width='65px';i.dataset.field=key;i.oninput=()=>{let v=Number(i.value);if(i.value!==''&&Number.isFinite(v))p[key]=Math.max(min,Math.min(max,v))};l.append(i);f.append(l)}let l=document.createElement('label'),c=document.createElement('input');c.type='checkbox';c.checked=p.visible;c.onchange=()=>p.visible=c.checked;l.append(c,' Visible');f.append(l)}
for(let p of assembly){let o=document.createElement('option');o.value=p.id;o.textContent=p.id;$('part').append(o)}
$('part').onchange=controls;controls();
$('resetPart').onclick=()=>{let p=selectedPart();Object.assign(p,defaults.find(d=>d.id===p.id));controls()};
$('resetAll').onclick=()=>{assembly=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(defaults));controls()};
$('exportRig').onclick=()=>{$('rigText').value=JSON.stringify(assembly);$('rigText').select();$('rigStatus').textContent='Settings exported. Copy the text to preserve or share it.'};
$('importRig').onclick=()=>{try{let raw=JSON.parse($('rigText').value);if(!Array.isArray(raw)||raw.length!==defaults.length)throw Error('Wrong part count');assembly=defaults.map(d=>{let p=raw.find(v=>v.id===d.id);if(!p)throw Error('Missing '+d.id);let a={...d};for(let [key,,min,max] of fields){if(!Number.isFinite(p[key]))throw Error('Invalid '+key);a[key]=Math.max(min,Math.min(max,p[key]))}a.visible=p.visible!==false;return a});controls();$('rigStatus').textContent='Imported settings'}catch(e){$('rigStatus').textContent=e.message}};
function assembledPose(x,y,k,b){if(Object.keys(P).length!==12)return;ctx.save();ctx.translate(x,y);ctx.scale(k,k);if($('ghost').checked&&I.newIron){let H=182,W=H*I.newIron.width/I.newIron.height;ctx.globalAlpha=.33;ctx.drawImage(I.newIron,-W/2,-H,W,H);ctx.globalAlpha=1}for(let p of [...assembly].sort((a,b)=>a.z-b.z)){if(!p.visible)continue;ctx.save();ctx.translate(p.x,p.y+(p.y<-80?b*-28:0));ctx.rotate(p.angle*rad);ctx.drawImage(P[p.asset],-p.w*p.ax,-p.h*p.ay,p.w,p.h);if($('joints').checked){ctx.fillStyle=p.id===$('part').value?'#fff':'#f6d069';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,0,2.2,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill()}ctx.restore()}ctx.restore()}

const canvas=$('c'), alphaMasks={}, clamp=(v,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v));
let drag=null, lastPick=null, pickedIndex=0;
function editing(){return $('mode').value==='Assembly'&&!$('old').checked}
function cursorPoint(e){let r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect(),k=+$('size').value/100;return {x:((e.clientX-r.left)*460/r.width-105)/k,y:((e.clientY-r.top)*294/r.height-280)/k}}
function local(p,x,y){let a=p.angle*rad,dx=x-p.x,dy=y-p.y;return {x:dx*Math.cos(a)+dy*Math.sin(a),y:-dx*Math.sin(a)+dy*Math.cos(a)}}
function world(p,x,y){let a=p.angle*rad;return {x:p.x+x*Math.cos(a)-y*Math.sin(a),y:p.y+x*Math.sin(a)+y*Math.cos(a)}}
function hit(p,pt){if(!p.visible||!P[p.asset])return false;let l=local(p,pt.x,pt.y),u=l.x/p.w+p.ax,v=l.y/p.h+p.ay;if(u<0||v<0||u>=1||v>=1)return false;
if(!alphaMasks[p.asset]){let im=P[p.asset],c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=im.width;c.height=im.height;let g=c.getContext('2d');g.drawImage(im,0,0);try{alphaMasks[p.asset]={w:c.width,h:c.height,d:g.getImageData(0,0,c.width,c.height).data}}catch(e){return true}}
let m=alphaMasks[p.asset];return m.d[(Math.floor(v*m.h)*m.w+Math.floor(u*m.w))*4+3]>35}
function handles(p){let L=-p.w*p.ax,T=-p.h*p.ay,R=L+p.w,B=T+p.h;return {rotate:world(p,(L+R)/2,T-12),corners:[[L,T],[R,T],[R,B],[L,B]].map(([x,y])=>world(p,x,y))}}
function near(a,b){return Math.hypot(a.x-b.x,a.y-b.y)<5/(+$('size').value/100)}
function syncFields(){let p=selectedPart();for(let i of $('partFields').querySelectorAll('[data-field]'))i.value=Number(p[i.dataset.field].toFixed(2))}
function choose(p){$('part').value=p.id;controls()}
canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{if(!editing()||e.button!==0)return;let pt=cursorPoint(e),p=selectedPart(),type='move',corner=-1;
if(p&&p.visible&&!e.altKey){let hs=handles(p);if(near(pt,hs.rotate))type='rotate';else{corner=hs.corners.findIndex(v=>near(pt,v));if(corner>=0)type='resize'}}
if(type==='move'){let hits=[...assembly].sort((a,b)=>b.z-a.z).filter(p=>hit(p,pt));if(!hits.length)return;let signature=hits.map(p=>p.id).join('|');pickedIndex=e.altKey&&signature===lastPick?(pickedIndex+1)%hits.length:0;lastPick=signature;p=hits[pickedIndex];choose(p)}
if(!p)return;drag={id:e.pointerId,p,type,corner,start:pt,original:{...p}};canvas.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);canvas.style.cursor=type==='move'?'grabbing':type==='rotate'?'crosshair':'nwse-resize';e.preventDefault()});
canvas.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{if(!editing()){canvas.style.cursor='default';return}let pt=cursorPoint(e);if(!drag){canvas.style.cursor=assembly.some(p=>hit(p,pt))?'grab':'default';return}if(drag.id!==e.pointerId)return;let {p,type,start,original:o}=drag;
if(type==='move'){p.x=clamp(o.x+pt.x-start.x,-160,160);p.y=clamp(o.y+pt.y-start.y,-230,20)}
else if(type==='rotate'){let a=Math.atan2(start.y-o.y,start.x-o.x),b=Math.atan2(pt.y-o.y,pt.x-o.x);p.angle=((o.angle+(b-a)/rad+540)%360)-180}
else{let l=local(o,pt.x,pt.y),s=local(o,start.x,start.y);let dx=drag.corner===0||drag.corner===3?-1:1,dy=drag.corner<2?-1:1;let fx=dx<0?o.ax:1-o.ax,fy=dy<0?o.ay:1-o.ay;let w=clamp(o.w+dx*(l.x-s.x)/Math.max(.1,fx),5,180),hh=clamp(o.h+dy*(l.y-s.y)/Math.max(.1,fy),5,180);if(!e.shiftKey){let ratio=Math.abs(w/o.w-1)>Math.abs(hh/o.h-1)?w/o.w:hh/o.h;ratio=clamp(ratio,Math.max(5/o.w,5/o.h),Math.min(180/o.w,180/o.h));w=o.w*ratio;hh=o.h*ratio}p.w=w;p.h=hh}
syncFields();e.preventDefault()});
function finish(e){if(drag&&drag.id===e.pointerId){drag=null;canvas.style.cursor='grab'}}canvas.addEventListener('pointerup',finish);canvas.addEventListener('pointercancel',finish);canvas.addEventListener('lostpointercapture',finish);
window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(!editing()||/INPUT|TEXTAREA|SELECT/.test(document.activeElement?.tagName||''))return;let p=selectedPart(),d=e.shiftKey?5:1;if(!p)return;let v={ArrowLeft:[-d,0],ArrowRight:[d,0],ArrowUp:[0,-d],ArrowDown:[0,d]}[e.key];if(v){p.x=clamp(p.x+v[0],-160,160);p.y=clamp(p.y+v[1],-230,20);syncFields();e.preventDefault()}});
function drawSelection(){if(!editing())return;let p=selectedPart();if(!p||!p.visible)return;let k=+$('size').value/100;ctx.save();ctx.translate(105,280);ctx.scale(k,k);ctx.translate(p.x,p.y);ctx.rotate(p.angle*rad);let L=-p.w*p.ax,T=-p.h*p.ay,R=L+p.w,B=T+p.h,M=(L+R)/2;ctx.strokeStyle='#f6d069';ctx.lineWidth=.8/k;ctx.setLineDash([3/k,2/k]);ctx.strokeRect(L,T,p.w,p.h);ctx.setLineDash([]);ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(M,T);ctx.lineTo(M,T-12);ctx.stroke();ctx.fillStyle='#f6d069';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(M,T-12,3/k,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();for(let [x,y] of [[L,T],[R,T],[R,B],[L,B]])ctx.fillRect(x-2/k,y-2/k,4/k,4/k);ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,0,1.8/k,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();ctx.restore()}
function crescent(x,y,k,q){let a=E((q-.32)/.08)*(1-E((q-.51)/.24));if(a<=0)return;ctx.save();ctx.translate(x+22*k,y-106*k);ctx.scale(k,k);let sweep=E((q-.30)/.23);ctx.globalCompositeOperation='screen';for(let j=0;j<3;j++){ctx.globalAlpha=a*[.19,.46,.95][j];ctx.strokeStyle=['#d88628','#ffbf48','#fff1bb'][j];ctx.lineWidth=[16,8,2.6][j];ctx.lineCap='round';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(16,-5,88,42,-.21,-1.16+sweep*.25,-1.16+sweep*3.18);ctx.stroke()}ctx.restore()}
function frame(now){if(last&&!paused)t+=Math.min(50,now-last)/1000;last=now;ctx.setTransform(2,0,0,2,0,0);ctx.clearRect(0,0,460,294);if(I.bg)ctx.drawImage(I.bg,0,0,460,294);else{ctx.fillStyle='#252936';ctx.fillRect(0,0,460,294)}let b=+$('breath').value/100,k=+$('size').value/100,q=$('mode').value==='Slash'?(t%1.25)/1.25:0; $('timeline').value=Math.round(q*1000);$('v').textContent=Math.round(b*100)+'%';$('sv').textContent=Math.round(k*100)+'%';let lunge=E((q-.27)/.22)*(1-E((q-.63)/.33)),x=105+23*lunge*k,y=280;contact(x,y-3,k,8*lunge);if($('old').checked&&I.newIron){let H=182*k,W=H*I.newIron.width/I.newIron.height;ctx.drawImage(I.newIron,x-W/2,y-H,W,H)}else if($('mode').value==='Slash')rigPose(x,y,k,q,.018*b*Math.sin(t*Math.PI*2/3.2)*(1-lunge));else assembledPose(x,y,k,$('mode').value==='Idle'?.018*b*Math.sin(t*Math.PI*2/3.2):0);crescent(x,y,k,q);if(I.fg)ctx.drawImage(I.fg,0,0,460,294);if(I.fade)ctx.drawImage(I.fade,0,256,460,38);drawSelection();requestAnimationFrame(frame)}requestAnimationFrame(frame);</script></body></html>
